answer: Agents bond stake to an identity commitment and evaluate its epoch polynomial, deriving rate-limit shares without exposing the secret. Semaphore proofs bind each message to a nullifier; reusing one produces distinct shares that permit Shamir reconstruction of the private key. The protocol can then slash the bonded collateral immediately. In tests, ferrous, atlas, and pigment label separate epochs, not security assumptions: Sybil resistance comes from scarce stake and enforceable duplicate-use penalties.
